Definition: from μῶλος ("moil"; probably akin to the base of G3433) and probably ὤψ (the face; from G3700); a mole ("black eye") or blow-mark:--stripe.
BiblicalUsage: Molops is a bruise, a weal, the mark of a blow — Peter says Christ bore our sins in His own body on the tree, that we should live unto righteousness, by whose stripes ye were healed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the bruise is the price written on His body: healing comes through wounds, not around them.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
